human_owner.summary: Approved in advance by the owner through auto mode; the Claude reviewer decides.

blocking_findings.finding: The assumptions say sideways trunk bending is not modeled. The right-hand frame clearly shows substantial lateral trunk flexion, with the torso tilted sideways toward the floor bell under an overhead load. Because lumbar_spine/lateral_flexion is missing, quadratus lumborum is a 0.105 stabilizer and the obliques are only 0.35 and 0.315 stabilizers. The pattern under-credits the trunk side-flexor and oblique work that defines a windmill and treats the core as a bystander.
blocking_findings.suggested_correction: Add lumbar_spine/lateral_flexion as a primary action so the quadratus lumborum and obliques are credited as movers or controllers of the side-bend.

blocking_findings.finding: The overhead elbow is held locked out under load throughout, but no action or demand credits the triceps, so all three heads are explicit zeros. An isometric lockout against a load needs the muscle credited. A demand alone (elbow_joint_integrity) would give only a trivial 0.07 to the medial head.
blocking_findings.suggested_correction: Add elbow_joint/extension with emphasis assist so the triceps register as synergists for the lockout.

non_blocking_findings.finding: hip_hinge is the right primary family. The trunk side-bend and anti-rotation component could also be labeled core_rotation or trunk_lateral_flexion for catalog search; this is only a label.
Frontal-plane hip control in the wide windmill stance is not represented, so gluteus medius is only a 0.2 synergist. This is minor and arguably covered by the hip actions.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_correction: Optionally consider pelvic_leveling_frontal or femoral_head_stabilization if the authors judge frontal hip control material.

model_reviewer.summary: The two-bell windmill is correctly read as a bilateral hip hinge with one bell locked out overhead and one reached to the floor. The frames show the trunk side-bending toward the floor bell, but the definition lists no trunk lateral-flexion action. It also credits no triceps for the loaded, locked-out overhead elbow. Both gaps are expressible with the edit operations. The hinge, the demands and the labels are otherwise reasonable.
